assertions.name: the_opaque_declaration_is_deleted
assertions.note: QOU/HeckeAlgebra/Wedderburn.lean. It read 'Using `axiom` keeps the embedding opaque pending concrete construction' and had no body. Deleted 2026-09-05, bean qou-kp2z. Counts DECLARATION lines, not occurrences of the string: the note left where it stood quotes the signature it retired, and a retirement note naming its subject must not read as the subject still being there

assertions.name: no_term_level_use_of_the_name_remains
assertions.note: scans every non-.lake Lean source with COMMENTS STRIPPED. An earlier version of this check filtered on a leading backtick instead, which counted every doc mention as a use -- including the retirement note itself. Stripping is the only version that would actually catch a real use

assertions.name: the_construction_defines_the_assembly_unconditionally
assertions.note: an ordinary def on Sigma lam, Fin (f^lam) x Fin (f^lam) -- no side condition, no opaque

assertions.name: and_proves_it_injective
assertions.note: so it is not the zero map. This answers the objection the deleted docstring raised: a stub returning 0 would contradict the Markov-trace structure. The objection was to a stub; the answer is a construction

assertions.name: the_rsk_step_is_isolated_as_a_named_hypothesis
assertions.note: Sigma_lam (f^lam)^2 = n! is a HYPOTHESIS on the Fin (n!) landing, discharged by nothing here -- not an assumption folded into the definition

assertions.name: the_signature_still_takes_a_decomposition_and_returns_one_matrix
assertions.note: blocks IN, ONE matrix OUT -- the SAME direction and arity the opaque had. The clause needs the opposite: one block's scalar C_{(2,1)} split into three coefficients. Building the map changed its status, not its shape. THIS is the fact that carries the conclusion

assertions.name: the_sibling_wedderburn_objects_are_weights_and_dimensions
assertions.note: none is a map of algebras. So the bridge is unavailable on BOTH readings: this object is opaque and mis-shaped, and anything else is undefined in the corpus

assertions.name: the_block_clause_is_still_marked_an_open_obligation
assertions.note: unified-iterative-correction-proof.md's (2,1) clause is ANNOTATED, not deleted -- the claim may well be true, it is simply unsupported, and a reader should not take it as derived

assertions.name: and_says_which_of_its_three_reasons_survived
assertions.note: the opaque and the fourth-axiom reasons are retired; the shape objection is not. A reader must not read 'the embedding was built' as 'the clause was discharged'

assertions.name: the_linear_no_go_is_a_lean_theorem
assertions.note: the shape objection is no longer only prose. Under linearity -- already assumed for the Markov trace -- three trace-factoring functionals at one partition are dependent

assertions.name: and_the_block_is_wider_than_its_trace
assertions.note: f^{(2,1)}=2 so the block is M_2(R), four dimensions to the trace's one. Recording the ROOM as well as the no-go, so this is not read as the clause being refuted

parameters.note: documentary + mechanical measurement; no Lean theorem is offered, and the docstring says why. Two of the three original facts are retired by construction (beans qou-usol, qou-kp2z); the shape objection stands and is what keeps the (2,1) clause an open obligation

declaration_lines: `opaque wedderburnEmbed` stood here until 2026-09-05 and is gone;
deleting it in favour of `wedderburnEmbedOf` is the clean
data.signature: noncomputable def wedderburnEmbedOf {n : ℕ} (h : RSKDimIdentity n) (x : WedderburnDecomposition n) : Matrix (Fin (heckeDim n)) (Fin (heckeDim n)) ℝ := Matrix.reindex (regIndexEquiv h) (regIndexEquiv h) (blockDiagonal x) /-- And it is injective, so it deserves the name "embedding". -/ theorem wedderburnEmbedOf_injective {n
